shortDescription: Create, update, or delete VAST Role resources

options.name: id
options.description: Resource ID for direct lookup. Mutually exclusive with name-based identification.

options.name: ldap_groups
options.description:
Associates group(s) with the role. A group can be any user group on an LDAP-based provider, including Active
Directory. The provider must be connected to the cluster. Members of the specified groups can access VMS and are
granted whichever permissions are included in the role. A group can be associated with multiple roles.

options.name: object_id
options.description: Object ID. Used to specify a particular object to limit the role to.

options.name: object_type
options.description: Object type. Used to specify a particular object to limit the role to.

options.name: permissions
options.description:
Permission type. Used to assign all the permissions of given type to a role. Can be used together with `realm` to
narrow resulting permissions list (logical AND). Ignored if provided along with `permissions_list`. Note, that
this is a legacy name, which does not correspond to the output schema's `permissions`.

options.name: permissions_list
options.description:
Specify permissions list as an array of permission codenames in the format <permission>-<realm>. To list
permission codenames, run /permissions/get. Takes precedence over `permissions` or `realm`.

options.name: realm
options.description:
Realm name. Used to assigned all the permissions of given realm to a role. Can be used together with
`permissions` to narrow resulting permissions list (logical AND). Ignored if provided along with
`permissions_list`.

options.name: tenant_id
options.description:
Pass this parameter to create a role for managers with user_type=TENANT_ADMIN (tenant admin users). Specifies the
ID of a single tenant to associate with the role. If not specified, the role is a cluster admin role. Corresponds
to `tenant` in the output schema.

options.name: tenant_ids
options.description: IDs of tenants to assign to the role. Corresponds to `tenants` on the output schema.

options.name: wait
options.description: Wait for async operations to complete.

options.name: wait_timeout
options.description: Timeout in seconds for async operations.
